# GH-300 Item Creator Source Pack

Use these sources in this order of precedence when writing GH-300 practice items.

## Source precedence

1. WWL exam constraints (exam safety and item psychometrics)
2. Microsoft Writing Style Guide voice principles
3. GH-300 objectives and Microsoft Learn product truth

## Local source files

- `working-temp/converted/style-guide.from-pdf.md` (converted from `working-temp/style-guide.pdf` via MarkItDown)
- `working-temp/mwsg-rules 2.md` (condensed Microsoft voice and style guidance)
- `working-temp/wwl-exam-rules.md` (exam-writing rules for choices, wording, and question quality)
- `working-temp/Worldwide Learning Exam Writing Style Guide_Q3FY23.docx.md` (full WWL style reference)
- `references/gh300-objectives.md` (January 2026 GH-300 domains and objectives)
- `references/fictional-companies.md` (scenario randomization pool)

## Non-negotiables

- Keep scenarios original and exam-realistic.
- Use current Copilot terminology.
- Do not use contractions.
- Do not use all/none of the above patterns.
- Keep distractors plausible and tied to real product behavior.
- Keep answer choices parallel in grammar and length so no option is an obvious tell.
